headline: Database replacement required: RDS instance will be destroyed and recreated
suppressed: Multiple pre-existing security findings from checkov (RDS logging, WAF, S3 replication, etc.) are not addressed by this PR and therefore not reported here.

findings.evidence_ref: Plan shows `-/+ resource "aws_db_instance.main" ... storage_encrypted false -> true # forces replacement`. The resource_changes section shows actions: ["delete","create"] with action_reason: "replace_because_cannot_update".
findings.explanation: Setting storage_encrypted to true on an existing RDS instance forces a full replacement (destroy then create). This destroys the production database, not just updates it. The PR description says "One-line change: storage_encrypted = true" which implies an in-place update, but Terraform will delete the current database and create a new one. While a final snapshot will be created (final_snapshot_identifier is set), this is a destructive operation that will cause production downtime and data loss unless explicitly managed. The team needs to understand they're not patching encryption on, they're replacing the entire database.
